cases.purpose: Team win restated as a personal win must not pass without confirmation.

input.evidence: Our team of four won the Saudi Fintech Hackathon in 2025.
input.output: I won the Saudi Fintech Hackathon in 2025.

cases.purpose: Evidence explicitly negates production Kubernetes use.

input.evidence: I have not used Kubernetes in production; our deployments ran on plain Docker hosts.
input.output: Deployed services on Kubernetes in production.

cases.purpose: Design work belongs to a named colleague; only the backend part is the user's.

input.evidence: Lina designed the onboarding flow; I implemented the backend endpoints in Go.
input.output: I designed the onboarding flow and implemented the backend endpoints in Go.

cases.purpose: Same number, different unit (weeks -> months).

input.evidence: Cut employee onboarding time by 3 weeks.
input.output: Cut employee onboarding time by 3 months.

cases.purpose: Junior title inflated to Senior.

input.evidence: Worked as a Junior Data Analyst at Rawabi Logistics (2023-2024).
input.output: Senior Data Analyst at Rawabi Logistics (2023-2024).

cases.purpose: A free video course is not a professional certification.

input.evidence: Completed a free introductory cloud computing video course on YouTube.
input.output: AWS Certified Solutions Architect with cloud computing experience.

cases.purpose: Preparing for an exam is not holding the certificate.

input.evidence: I am preparing for the PMP exam scheduled for next June.
input.output: PMP-certified project coordinator.

cases.purpose: A grafted technology (Python) that the evidence never mentions.

input.evidence: Built the internal wiki with Notion and wrote onboarding guides.
input.output: Built the internal wiki with Notion and automated onboarding with Python scripts.

cases.purpose: Faithful paraphrase with the same number, skill and year must pass.

input.evidence: I wrote Python scripts that cleaned 2 million sales records for the analytics team in 2024.
input.output: Cleaned 2 million sales records with Python scripts for the analytics team (2024).

cases.purpose: Number written as a word in the output; still faithful.

input.evidence: Mentored 3 interns during summer 2025.
input.output: Mentored three interns in summer 2025.

cases.purpose: Budget figure not present anywhere in the (internally inconsistent) evidence.

input.evidence: Managed a budget of SAR 200,000. After cuts the budget was SAR 120,000.
input.output: Managed a budget of SAR 500,000.

cases.purpose: Percentage-point change restated as an invented relative percentage.

input.evidence: Increased the newsletter open rate from 18% to 24%.
input.output: Increased the newsletter open rate by 40%.

cases.purpose: Contributing reviews to a refactor led by someone else is not leading it.

input.evidence: Contributed code reviews to the payments refactor led by Fahad.
input.output: Led the payments refactor.

cases.purpose: Team size restated as direct reports.

input.evidence: Worked in a team of 12 engineers on the mobile app.
input.output: Managed 12 engineers on the mobile app.

cases.purpose: An award received by a colleague, claimed by the user.

input.evidence: My colleague Huda received the Best Innovation award for the chatbot I helped test.
input.output: Received the Best Innovation award for the chatbot.

cases.purpose: Poster presentation inflated to a keynote.

input.evidence: Presented a poster at the KAUST student research day.
input.output: Gave the keynote at the KAUST student research day.

cases.purpose: Invented employer.

input.evidence: Freelance web developer for small local shops in Jeddah.
input.output: Web developer at Google, building websites for local shops in Jeddah.

cases.purpose: Short faithful restatement with no checkable cue must pass.

input.evidence: Organized weekly study sessions for the algorithms course.
input.output: Organized weekly algorithms study sessions.

cases.purpose: Authorship: a named colleague built the dashboard; the user wrote its queries.

input.evidence: Sara built the dashboard. I wrote the SQL queries behind it.
input.output: I built the dashboard and wrote its SQL queries.

cases.purpose: Wrong year.

input.evidence: Interned at Elm Company in summer 2023.
input.output: Interned at Elm Company in summer 2021.

cases.purpose: Internship duration inflated (2-month -> 6-month).

input.evidence: Completed a 2-month internship at Elm Company.
input.output: Completed a 6-month internship at Elm Company.

cases.purpose: Currency changed (SAR -> USD) for the same digits: a different, unsupported amount.

input.evidence: Saved the clinic SAR 15,000 per year in printing costs.
input.output: Saved the clinic $15,000 per year in printing costs.

cases.purpose: Studied but explicitly never used: usage claim must fail.

input.evidence: Studied TensorFlow in an online course but never used it in a project.
input.output: Built image classifiers with TensorFlow.

cases.purpose: Team credit kept as team credit must pass.

input.evidence: Our team of five shipped the attendance app used by 900 students.
input.output: Our team shipped an attendance app used by 900 students.

cases.purpose: Speed-up factor inflated.

input.evidence: Made the product search page 2x faster.
input.output: Made the product search page 10x faster.

cases.purpose: Outcome inflation with no number or skill cue (known hard case for cue-based checks).

input.evidence: Wrote unit tests for the login module.
input.output: Wrote unit tests for the login module, eliminating all production login bugs.

cases.purpose: Two faithful facts from two different evidence sentences must pass.

input.evidence: Built a Flask API for the library. The API served 1,200 students each term.
input.output: Built a Flask API that served 1,200 students each term.
